def has_matching_key(env):
    return env.carrying is not None and env.carrying.type == "key" and any(c is not None and c.type == "door" and c.color == env.carrying.color for y in range((env.room_size - 1) * (max([yy for xx in range(env.width) for yy in range(env.height) for cell in [env.grid.get(xx, yy)] if cell is not None and cell.type == "ball"] or [env.agent_pos[1]]) // (env.room_size - 1)), (env.room_size - 1) * (max([yy for xx in range(env.width) for yy in range(env.height) for cell in [env.grid.get(xx, yy)] if cell is not None and cell.type == "ball"] or [env.agent_pos[1]]) // (env.room_size - 1)) + env.room_size) for c in [env.grid.get(env.width - env.room_size, y)])
